picks.headline: Apple is making your security camera smarter. What comes next is more interesting.
picks.excerpt: Apple, Google, and Ring are teaching security cameras what matters
picks.rationale: Fresh cross-platform look at how Apple Intelligence, Gemini and Alexa+ are reshaping home-camera event detection; not covered in the last 5 days.

picks.headline: If you can't tell what's real or AI-generated anymore, this Android app is here to help
picks.excerpt: How do you determine what is an AI-generated image and what is real? If you find this a tall task, this Android app has the answer.
picks.rationale: Practical C2PA provenance checker on the phone, directly useful to anyone publishing or vetting imagery; new tool, no prior coverage.

picks.headline: The PixelMob is a near-perfect mini AI workstation for creators
picks.excerpt: The PixelMob is a portable workstation for photographers, videographers and creators with storage, AI file management, editing, monitoring and tethered shooting
picks.rationale: Hands-on review of a portable AI file-management/editing box for photo and video creators; high actionability, freshest item in the pool.

picks.headline: Here's what Magic Pointer processes on your Googlebook — and what goes online

picks.rationale: New disclosure of Magic Pointer's on-device vs cloud AI split; distinct from the 09-22 Googlebook pricing card (different URL and content).

picks.headline: Siri just got a major AI upgrade — here are 5 things to try first

picks.rationale: Hands-on, use-case-driven guide to the new Siri AI; gadgets history has no dedicated Siri AI card, and it adds a fourth outlet.
